Facts stated for imaging: diagnostic radiology services (e.g. MRI, CAT Scan) and outpatient X-rays. Diagnostic radiology is "other than X-rays, priced together", so I map it to `imaging.diagnostic`. The examples (MRI, CAT scan) are not an exhaustive list, so I don't use the advanced benefit. Urgent care, labs and therapeutic radiology are not imaging, so I leave them out.

Quote uniqueness: "$0 - $300 copay*" appears once, but I drop the asterisk. Quoting "Diagnostic radiology services" plus the network column would mix columns. I use the cost text alone where it is unique.

- "$0 - $300 copay" appears once on the page.
- "$0 - $60 copay" appears once.
- The 50% coinsurance lines repeat, so each one needs a row-specific quote. A row quote would span both plan columns and the in-network text, which is messy. I use quotes that read across the row as it is printed, for example "Out-of-Network Out-of-Network 50% coinsurance 50% coinsurance". That text is not certain to match the page exactly once, so I choose the following. For the diagnostic radiology out-of-network cost, I quote "(e.g. MRI, CAT Scan) $0 - $300 copay* $0 - $60 copay*" for the in-network facts. For out-of-network and X-ray I use short quotes with neighboring words, which carries some risk. Since a wrong fact is worse than a missing one, I include only the in-network facts, where the quotes are reliable.

For X-rays, "Outpatient X-rays In-Network $0 copay* $0 copay*" is not safe, since the text is split across lines. I use "Outpatient X-rays" with "$0 copay", which is not unique. I therefore include the X-ray facts with a quote of the row's service name plus the amount, accepting the risk, because the amount is the same for both plans.

{"plan_id":"H7006-018-0","benefit":"imaging.diagnostic","setting":"any","network":"in","covered_by":"medicare","cost_kind":"copay","amount":"$0-$300","quotes":["$0 - $300 copay"],"page":7},
{"plan_id":"H7006-021-0","benefit":"imaging.diagnostic","setting":"any","network":"in","covered_by":"medicare","cost_kind":"copay","amount":"$0-$60","quotes":["$0 - $60 copay"],"page":7}
]
